text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 23,440.8, up 1.68% on the day and 3.02% over the past five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 1.58% (5‑day gain 2.93%). Advances outpaced declines (395 vs 94) giving a neutral breadth score of 44.4. The move was fairly broad, with 311 stocks advancing versus 183 declining in the Nifty 500 universe.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding INR 6,836.81 crore today and a cumulative INR 15,309.51 crore over the last five days, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold INR 3,678.85 crore. The FII streak is five buying days, DII a three‑day sell streak. Leading sectors were Pharma, Infrastructure, Oil & Gas, Healthcare, PSU Bank and Commodities; IT and Private Bank stocks were weakening. Options data show a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 1.93 for Nifty, indicating more puts than calls, with max‑pain at 23,700 and a call wall at 23,850. Bank Nifty PCR is near‑neutral at 0.97, max‑pain 55,600 and a symmetric call/put wall at 58,000.

Watch the Nifty 50 pivot levels: support at 23,284.97 (S1) and pivot at 23,362.88; resistance at 23,518.72 (R1). A break below S1 could test the 20‑day moving average (≈23,090) while a hold above the pivot may allow a move toward the call wall at 23,850. For Bank Nifty, key levels are S1 54,707.35, pivot 54,876.85 and R1 55,171.7. Global cues such as the USD‑INR at 94.73 (‑0.18% today) and modest Brent dip may influence sentiment in the next session.
